description: Create or update a test plan — a named, reusable set of case IDs such as a smoke or regression pack. With `id` it updates, without it creates. qase_regression_run turns a plan into a run in one call. Cost: one API call, about 0.5s, growing with the number of cases.

id.description: Plan ID — if provided, updates; if omitted, creates

name: qase_plan_upsert
title: Create or update test plan
